faq.question: How do I track my package?
faq.answer: Use the tracking number from your confirmation email or order page. If the shipment is already in transit, you can check the carrier portal for the latest status.

faq.question: What if my delivery is delayed?
faq.answer: Check the latest carrier update first. If the delay lasts more than 48 hours, contact support and share the tracking number for further help.

faq.question: How do I return an item?
faq.answer: Open the order details page, select the item, and follow the return instructions. A return label may be provided if the return is eligible.

faq.question: How can I update my delivery address?
faq.answer: Address updates are usually possible before the shipment is dispatched. Contact support as soon as possible with the order number and the new address.

faq.question: What should I do if my package is lost?
faq.answer: Report the issue to support with the order number and tracking details. The team can help open a claim and review the shipment history.

faq.question: How should I compare open-source models for my capstone?
faq.answer: Evaluate each model on the same test set and compare quality, latency, resource usage, and fit for your task.

faq.question: What should I include in the evaluation section?
faq.answer: Include quantitative metrics, qualitative review, error analysis, and a discussion of trade-offs and limitations.

faq.question: How do I document responsible AI practices?
faq.answer: Describe fairness, safety, privacy, transparency, and known limitations with mitigation steps and evidence.

faq.question: How can I structure the project report for a capstone?
faq.answer: Use a clear structure with problem statement, methods, experiments, results, evaluation, limitations, and future work.
